summary: Iteration 28 (Patch & Pot) — verified all 5 growth/quality items end-to-end. (a) Plant OG card endpoints render valid PNG, HTML preview wrapper carries og:title='How to grow Tomato — Patch & Pot' + og:image + twitter:card='summary_large_image', 404 for unknown plants. SPA at /plants/tomato injects matching og:image/width=1200 + twitter:card meta and document.title. (b) /embed/p/{shareId} renders EmbedPatchPage with header_count=0, footer_count=0, embed-patch/name/plants/open-full all visible, open-full href='/p/{sid}' target='_top'. (c) /api/share/patch/{sid}/qr.pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF magic, pypdf text extracts 'PATCH', 'POT', 'SCAN', and the patch name. 404 on unknown id. (d) View counter: first visit per IP+UA fingerprint increments view_count, refresh from same fingerprint is debounced (no increment), 5 bot UAs (facebookexternalhit, Twitterbot, WhatsApp, Slackbot, Googlebot) all skipped. /api/share/patches/popular returns only list_publicly=true snapshots with ≥1 plant; opt-in toggle round-trips via owner-secret POST update. Homepage shows 'Most-loved patches this week' section with one card per public opt-in patch. View-count line on /p/{sid} reads '1 visits this week'. (e) i18n lazy-load works perfectly: EN nav 'Home/Monthly Guide/Plants/…' → click EN button → 'Deutsch' triggers a fetch of 'i18n-de-js.chunk.js', DE nav becomes 'Start/Monatsführer/Pflanzen/Meisterkurse/Mein Garten/Wohlbefinden/Anleitungen', <html lang>='de'. Switching to Japanese loads its own chunk, nav shows CJK ('ホーム/月間ガイド/植物/…'), <html lang>='ja'. Switching back to English fires 0 additional /static/js/ chunks (statically imported fallback), nav back to English, no raw-key flashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Pluralisation nit: view-count line shows '1 visits this week' instead of '1 visit this week' — pluralisation logic in SharedPatch.jsx should special-case n===1. Cosmetic only.

share.py: /api/share/patches/popular sort is ('view_count', -1) — globally hot patches will dominate forever. Spec says 'Most-loved patches THIS WEEK'. Consider sorting on 'view_count_7d' (already being incremented alongside view_count) so the wall actually reflects the week. Today view_count_7d is incremented but never read.

share.py: shared_patch_views collection relies on the server.py startup TTL index to evict 24h fingerprints. If that index is ever missing, the dedup row stays forever and a returning fan would never have their second visit count after 24h. Suggest a tiny smoke test in CI that asserts the TTL index exists on shared_patch_views.expires_at.

i18n/index.jsx: per-locale dynamic imports include webpackChunkName so DE = i18n-de-js.chunk.js — clean. Worth keeping the EN fallback assertion (already tested) as a CI guard if anyone ever swaps the static import to dynamic; raw-key flash is the worst possible UX regression.
seed_data_creation: All test snapshots cleaned up via DELETE in fixture teardown / try-finally blocks. No TEST_iter28 rows remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter28 backend coverage at /app/backend/tests/test_iter28.py (12 tests across TestPlantOg, TestQrSticker, TestViewCounter, TestListPublicly, TestPopularWall). Combined with /app/backend/tests/test_share_patch.py the share+plant-OG surface has 25 green tests. The dedup key in shared_patch_views is `{share_id}:{fp24}` so fingerprints derived from IP+UA repeat-visit within 24h won't increment view_count — make sure any new test uses unique UA strings if it wants fresh counts. i18n lazy chunks are named i18n-{code}-js.chunk.js (webpackChunkName).
